messages:
maria-l: Morning — quick ask. We have a customer demo next Sat 2026-04-04 14:00 UTC. Can EU fleet spare 4x A100 (16GB) for a 3-hour reserved window? Need to lock reservation and a fallback plan if any racking/firmware delays. PR: https://git.internal/r/procurement/pull/412

jake-chen: Pinged vendor-ops, added to procurement tracker: https://g.docs/track/sku. Do we need sustained throughput or burst? If sustained, we'll reserve as dedicated; if burst, can try standby borrow.

ashley: For terraform we have a label `demo-slate/2026-04-04`, PR 412 adds the pool. If vendor can't confirm by Thu EOD, we'll flip to preemptible blend. cc @natalie-vendor

samir: Can we pre-warm KV cache? Also suggest reducing sequence length in smoke test. Fallback plan: fallback to 2x h100 spot + 2x a100 preemptible. Will write runbook snippet.

natalie-vendor: Vendor ops here — short answer: we can commit 4x A100 for the window but need a heads-up 36h before. There's a firmware update scheduled on 2026-04-02 for the rack, but it's low-risk. I can mark soft-reserve and confirm Monday. ETA 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC to confirm.

maria-l: Thanks! I'll update the PR and schedule the 36h notice. Small ask: can we get serials for inventory to add to the ticket? helps audit.

natalie-vendor: Yep — sending serials to the ticket once confirmed. Also setting capacity flag: soft_reserve:true

deploy-bot: reservation.created: id=rsv_20260404_demo, window=2026-04-04T14:00Z..17:00Z, owner=maria-l

ashley: Added runbook stub: ```steps:
 - notify vendor 36h
 - create soft-reserve
 - run smoke with seq=512
 - revert if latency > 120ms
```

samir: :thumbsup: I'll own the smoke test. tagging @jake-chen for terraform apply window.

jake-chen: Got it; will schedule apply Fri 20:00 UTC. If vendor confirms earlier we can move up. Thanks team.
